population: Tickets in the systematic 1-in-8 shipped-ticket sample (scripts/survey-reliability-tracker.mjs shippedSample) first merged June–September 2026, whose comments show a code review and contain a review-headed comment matching a send-back pattern (request changes, blocker, ❌). The pattern over-selects; comments that were not send-backs carry no blockers.
method: Every send-back review comment, truncated at 6,000 characters, read by three in-session subagents, one batch each, against this rubric fixed before reading; a finding repeated in a later round counted once. Not second-read.

rubric.bug: a correctness fault in the change under review that would have shipped wrong product behaviour had it merged: wrong output, crash/hang, broken UI, security or credential flaw, data loss, or the change not taking effect.
rubric.coverage: missing or wrong test, witness or mutation proof, behaviour not shown wrong.
rubric.record: a false or unsupported claim in the PR, ticket, close-out or docs.
rubric.scope-design: scope, design preference, naming, structure, style.
rubric.process: ledger, CI evidence, template compliance, rebase.
